title: moula ali ali moula ali ali
body:
deen ka daata jagat ka malik sab ka paalan haar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
tere charn ki dhool ke aage kya chandi kya sona hai
dharti chand sitare sab kuch tere husn ka sadqa hai
tera paseena...
hai tere maathe ka paseena nabi wali autaar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
tere siwa wo koun hai jis ke dar pe taara utra hai
dharti se aakash talak bas tera sikka chalta hai
mere moula...
sooraj tere hukm se nikla ek din me do baar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
poorab pashchim uttar dakshin sehme sehme rehte hai
qouf se tere pankh samete door farishte rehte hai
aye balhaari...
chalti hai anyay ke aage jab teri talwar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
nainou me teri yaad ki jyoti zehan me teri moorat hai
saans me tere naam ki maala man me pyaar ki doulat hai
aye jag daata...
mere badan ke roum roum par hai tera upkaar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
meesum salma'n aur abuzar sab ham ko pehchane hai
teri gali ke bikshu hai ham qambar ham ko jaane hai
bhej de moula...
bhej de ab hasnain ka sadqa karde beda paar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
teri khushi me qush hote hai tere gham me rote hai
dhaage me ehsaas ke daata akshar ko pirote hai
teri maala...
teri maala japte hai ham mimbar ho ya daar
moula ali ali moula ali ali
